index.name: Edvvrdd Reaper tools for Game audio

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Major rebuild: new Sequential sampling mode, Doppler envelope section, Resample to folder, and UI enhancements

reapack.name: CurveGenerator.lua
reapack.desc: Haptic curve generator — exports audio as Unreal/Unity/Godot curves

metadata.description: Turns a REAPER audio item into a haptic feedback curve and exports it for Unreal (CSV), Unity (AnimationCurve JSON) or Godot 4 (.tres)

reapack.name: Create_Or_Sync_Multiband_Rig.lua
reapack.desc: Multiband splitting rig — LR4 band-split folder (Multipass-style)

metadata.description: Turns the selected track into a multiband host folder: items are cloned into color-coded [LOW]/[MID]/[HIGH] bucket children split by phase-coherent Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order (24 dB/oct) JSFX filters, summing flat into the parent (which keeps your FX chain plus an output visualizer). Re-run on the rig to open a control window with live crossover sliders. Values persist on the parent track.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Bucket redesign: no [SOURCE IN] — items cloned into each band child. ReaImGui control window with live crossover sliders. MB_Visualizer.jsfx scope + band meters on the rig parent. Fixed band-mode param normalization.

reapack.name: MB_Filter_Band.jsfx
reapack.desc: MB Filter Band — LR4 24 dB/oct band-split filter (LP/BP/HP)

metadata.description: Per-track Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order (24 dB/oct) band filter for multiband splitting: Low (LP), Mid (BP) or High (HP) mode with two crossover sliders. Installs to Effects/SoundDesignTools/ for the Create_Or_Sync_Multiband_Rig.lua script.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Added gmem band-level meter output for MB_Visualizer.jsfx.

reapack.name: MB_Visualizer.jsfx
reapack.desc: MB Rig Visualizer — output scope + per-band meters

metadata.description: Passthrough JSFX for the [MB Rig] parent folder: scrolling peak scope of the summed band output plus navy/amber/cyan level meters fed by the MB_Filter_Band instances via shared gmem.
